0: Ordinance – Water and Sewage Deposit City of Santa Claus, Georgia The Council of the City of Santa Claus hereby ordains: 1- A deposit shall be made to the City prior to water and sewerage services being provided to ay resident or business requesting such services. 2 - The deposit shall be left with the City until such time as the depositor terminates said services by request made to the city clerk. At such time The deposit shall first be used to satisfy any unpaid water and sewerage charges up to and including the date of requested termination. The balance, if any, shall then be refunded to the depositor of record. 3 - No interest shall be paid by the City on any such funds. 4 - Violators of this ordinance, as adopted, shall be subject to a fine of no less than seventy-five ($75.00) dollars. 5 - Any and all prior ordinances, if such exist, pertaining to water and sewerage deposits are hereby repealed. 6 - Amount of deposit: Residential: Twenty-five ($25.00) dollars Commercial: Fifty ($50.00) dollars
